evidence: git show HEAD:src/ui/MappingRows.tsx | wc -l reports 835; wc -l src/ui/MappingRows.tsx reports 1121.

src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:734 begins the column settings dialog; its recipe/type/validation UI continues through line 1085, inside the same MappingRows function that owns matching, suggestions and ordering.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the column-settings dialog body, including recipe mode initialization, fixed-value editing, output type and validation controls, into a ColumnSettings component receiving the selected field, source columns and field update/match callbacks. Keep dialog focus/lifecycle and matching workspace state in MappingRows; retain CalculationSettings and NumericSettings as its existing child controls. This moves a coherent editing responsibility out of the oversized workspace without adding a generic registry or duplicating recipe logic.
findings.title: Extract column settings before MappingRows crosses 1,000 lines

evidence: src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:128: rounding: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:129: scale: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:130: wholeNumber: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:150: update(id, { type: "text", recipe: { kind: "copy", source: key } });

Configure a copy from source A as number with wholeNumber=true, then choose source B through the Copy source selector. Its onChange invokes match(field.id, e.target.value), which supplies type=text; the new update branch deletes all numeric policies.

If B contains 1.5 or 'four', recipes.ts skips numeric validation because f.type is now text, leaving an optional destination valid and exportable. This crosses the source-selection/editor boundary into numeric validation and can silently change a saved workflow's business rule.
findings.first_evidence: src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:128: rounding: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:129: scale: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:130: wholeNumber: undefined,; src/ui/MappingRows.tsx:150: update(id, { type: "text", recipe: { kind: "copy", source: key } });
findings.suggested_fix: Have match preserve the destination's existing output type and compatible field policies when replacing a source reference, instead of always passing type=text. Explicit Output type changes should remain responsible for clearing incompatible settings. Verify remapping a whole-number numeric copy to fractional and nonnumeric sources retains its validation errors.
findings.title: Changing numeric source silently removes validation

findings.suggested_fix: For an existing copy recipe, change only the recipe source and preserve the field's output type and numeric settings. Reserve the explicit text reset for transitions from another recipe mode when required. Add a regression scenario that configures a numeric copy with wholeNumber/scale/rounding, changes its source, and verifies those settings and invalid-row behavior remain intact.
findings.title: Preserve numeric settings when changing a copy source

testing_gaps: tests/unit/decimal.test.ts exercises terminating denominators and recurring denominators, but never a quotient that terminates only after cancelling a non-2/5 factor (for example 3 / 6 = 0.5). Add that case, preferably with a negative divisor too, to protect the new gcd/reduction path in src/engine/decimal.ts.

The new resource tests cover the 1000-character input guard and the division-scale guard, but do not exercise finish/checkSize's 2000-digit result guard. Add accepted-boundary and rejected-overflow cases using legal operands, including a large multiplication with explicit rounding places, and assert the numeric-limit error code. This protects the separate result-expansion bound rather than only input and division bounds.
